appDescription.message: Private end-to-end encrypted Android notification mirroring.

popupNoMatchingNotificationsBody.message: Choose another source to view its current notifications.

popupSetupRequiredBody.message: Open settings to join this Chrome device to your private service.

popupConnectionUnavailableBody.message: Current notifications remain available in this browser. Check that your private service is running.

popupNoNotificationsBody.message: New notifications from authorized Android devices will appear here.

popupConnectingBody.message: Current notifications will appear here after the connection is ready.

popupBoundary.message: After trusted-device approval, only notifications created by this app can be synchronized. Notifications from other apps remain on Android.

e2eeTestHint.message: Run again after restarting Chrome. The fingerprint must stay identical; replay is accepted once, then rejected as duplicate.

e2eeNotRun.message: Not run in this browser yet.

registrationBoundary.message: Registration grants access to a private instance. It does not trust other devices for E2EE. Real notification synchronization remains disabled until trusted-device approval and relay validation are complete.

createOffer.message: Create offer on this Chrome device

profileRegistered.message: This Chrome profile is registered. Connection status is available in the extension popup.

reconnectRequested.message: Authenticated transport restart requested. Check the popup for connection status.

reconnectRejected.message: Authenticated transport restart was not accepted. Try again after checking the server.

reconnectFailed.message: Authenticated transport restart failed. Check the server and try again.

hostPermissionDenied.message: Server access was not granted. Registration was not attempted.

waitingForAdminApproval.message: Registration received. Ask your server administrator to approve this Chrome profile.

registrationFailed.message: Registration failed. Verify the server address, one-time code, and device name.

registrationUnreadable.message: Stored registration state could not be read. Reopen this page; if the problem remains, register again.

shortcutSettingsDescription.message: Choose which actions are easiest to reach from Chrome notifications.

shortcutPinClearDescription.message: Keep Clear available for the notification on your phone.

shortcutPriorityDescription.message: Rules are checked from top to bottom. Use the move buttons to change priority.

shortcutNoRules.message: No priority rules. Other actions remain available after opening the notification.

shortcutNoApplications.message: No application has sent a notification to this browser yet

shortcutRuleInvalid.message: Enter action text for the highlighted rule.

shortcutSaveFailed.message: Changes were not saved. Check every rule and try again.

shortcutLoadFailed.message: Shortcut settings could not be loaded. Reload the settings page.

shortcutSyncDescription.message: Every browser in your workspace shares one set of rules. Saving here uploads them, and this browser adopts changes made elsewhere when it starts and periodically while it runs. They are encrypted before they are uploaded, so the server cannot read the keywords.

shortcutSyncOff.message: Rules are stored in this browser only.

shortcutSyncOn.message: Rules are shared with the other browsers in your workspace.

shortcutSyncOnWithTime.message: Rules are shared with the other browsers in your workspace. Last synced $TIME$.

shortcutSyncUnavailable.message: The sync state could not be read. Reload the settings page.

shortcutSyncPassphraseHint.message: Enter the same passphrase in every browser that should share these rules. Only your browsers can decrypt them; the server stores ciphertext.

shortcutSyncPublished.message: Synchronization is on. This browser's rules were uploaded.

shortcutSyncAdopted.message: Synchronization is on, and the rules already in your workspace were adopted.

shortcutSyncUpdated.message: The rules were updated from your workspace.

shortcutSyncUpToDate.message: The rules are already up to date.

shortcutSyncTurnedOff.message: Synchronization is off. This browser's rules and the uploaded copy are both kept.

shortcutSyncWrongPassphrase.message: That passphrase is wrong. The rules were left unchanged.

shortcutSyncConflict.message: Another browser changed the rules first. Sync now, then save again.

shortcutSyncNotEnrolled.message: This browser has not joined the workspace yet, so it cannot sync rules.

shortcutSyncDenied.message: The workspace refused this sync. This device may have been removed.

interactionNoSourceActions.message: This notification does not provide any actions.

interactionReplyLimit.message: Wait for your Android device to confirm the result before leaving this page.

interactionReplyOnAndroid.message: Use your Android device to respond to this action.

interactionReplyTooLong.message: The reply is too long. Shorten it and try again.

interactionReplyFailed.message: Your Android device could not send the reply. Open the latest notification and try again.

interactionReplyUnknown.message: No result was received. Check the conversation on your Android device before trying again.

interactionRequestSent.message: Request sent. The result will be synchronized when your Android device responds.

interactionRequestQueued.message: Request saved. It will be sent when the connection returns.

interactionRequestUnavailable.message: The request could not be sent. Check the connection and try again.

interactionChanged.message: The notification changed. Open it again to use its latest actions.

interactionClearRefused.message: Your Android device refused to clear this notification. Clear it on the phone.

interactionClearRefusedListener.message: Your Android device has no usable notification access right now, so it cannot clear this remotely. Check SevenMirror's notification access on the phone.

interactionClearRefusedOngoing.message: This is an ongoing notification, so Android does not allow clearing it remotely. Clear it on the phone.

interactionClearStale.message: This notification was already updated. Clear the newest one.

interactionResultPending.message: Your Android device has not confirmed the result yet. Check this notification on the phone later.

interactionResultUnknown.message: No result was received. Check this notification on your Android device.

interactionUnavailableTitle.message: This notification is no longer available

interactionUnavailableBody.message: It may have been cleared or updated on your Android device.

optionsJoinBody.message: Generate a one-time Chrome joining code in the SevenMirror server administration page.

optionsGuidance_not_configured.message: Join your private SevenMirror service to receive notifications.

optionsGuidance_waiting_approval.message: The request is saved. Ask the server administrator to approve this Chrome device.

optionsWaitingApprovalHint.message: Once an administrator approves this device, this page updates on its own — there is nothing to press here.

optionsGuidance_connecting.message: Your settings are ready while SevenMirror connects to the private service.

optionsGuidance_online.message: This Chrome device can receive notifications from authorized Android devices.

optionsGuidance_offline.message: Check that the private service is running, then reconnect.

optionsGuidance_access_removed.message: The server administrator removed this Chrome device. Clear its old access before registering it again.

optionsReEnrollConfirmBody.message: Its previous access has been removed. SevenMirror will clear the old workspace access from this Chrome profile, then return to setup.

optionsReEnrollFailed.message: The old access could not be cleared. Reload this page to continue safely.

optionsReEnrollReady.message: Old access cleared. Enter a new joining code to register this device again.

optionsGuidance_resetting.message: The old access still needs to be cleared. Continue to return this Chrome device to setup.

optionsGuidance_needs_repair.message: SevenMirror cannot continue with the saved access information. Ask the server administrator to remove this device before registering it again.

optionsDevicesBody.message: Devices authorized to use this SevenMirror workspace.

optionsDevicesUnavailable.message: Device information will be available after approval.

optionsDeviceAdminBoundary.message: Approve, reject, or remove devices in the server administration page.

optionsBadgeBody.message: Show how many notifications you have not opened yet.

optionsSourcesBody.message: Choose which authorized Android devices appear on this Chrome device.

optionsSourcesEmpty.message: No authorized Android source is available.

optionsNativeNotificationsBody.message: Show new notifications outside the SevenMirror window.

optionsShowBodyBody.message: Show notification text in SevenMirror and browser notifications.

optionsShowImagesBody.message: Use images supplied by Android in browser notifications.

optionsSilentNotificationsBody.message: Show browser notifications without a sound.

optionsLocalDisplayBoundary.message: Browser display settings affect only this Chrome device. Android controls which notifications may leave the phone.

optionsSaveFailed.message: The setting could not be saved. Try again.

optionsLocalDataBody.message: Current mirrored notifications are stored only in this Chrome profile.

optionsLocalDataBoundary.message: Clearing affects only this Chrome device. Notifications on your phone and authorized devices are untouched.

optionsClearConfirmBody.message: This removes notifications saved in this Chrome profile. New notifications can arrive again.

optionsLocalNotificationsCleared.message: The local notification list was cleared.

optionsClearFailed.message: The local notification list could not be cleared. Try again.
